projection.description: Fixed shared CityVerse origin and local metric convention; never recenter per city.

ownership: area-weighted footprint centroid, before quantization; one record per OSM identity
coordinates: worldX = tx * tileSize + localX * quantization; worldZ = tz * tileSize + localZ * quantization; north = negative Z
stringReferences: name and sparse tag value IDs index tile.strings; 0 means absent
inferencePolicy: Inferred category, height and roof are procedural rendering inputs, never verified real-world metadata; explicit means tagged in OSM, not independently surveyed
source: Local Geofabrik Nigeria OSM PBF (build-time only)

roadAnalysis.method: Approximate summed footprint/carriageway rectangle intersection area; holes excluded; no geometry moved
